name: Takazawa Miaya
source:
Hobbies: Cooking
Likes: Waking up [url=/c64279]Haruta[/url] every morning, Japanese sweets
Dislikes: Crowds, bell peppers

Haruta's childhood friend and neighbor who loves spoiling him. Has loved Haruta ever since they were kids and is not afraid to speak about her childhood dream of becoming his wife. Has a habit of secretly moving the bell peppers (which Miaya dislikes) into Haruta's dishes.
